Reasons used in 'allowed': invitation = a real call into researcher, which Brahm allowed on 2026-10-13 because it invites the user to install researcher; signpost = tells the user or the caller that something is another skill's job, and calls nothing; conditional = a step that runs only when the higher plugin is installed (for file-manager: a step that moves, renames or trashes a file stops and tells the practitioner, never falling back to a shell move or delete), or only on work one of its skills created, and that says what happens without it; caller = describes a higher skill that calls this one; mention = a comparison, an example or a description.
